body.name: Multivariate relational target polynomial
body.construction: For \(p\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{free}}\), \(\Phi(p)\) is obtained by replaying the finite truncated target factorization encoded by \(S,G,\rho,a,B,Ictx\), substituting the rational supported rows \(K\) and substituting \(p_{r,y}\) whenever an occurrence has key \(r\in\mathcal R_{\mathrm{free}}\).
